title: Vanishing of a wedge containing one more vector than the source rank
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], A a finite locally free module sheaf of rank r [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module], B any module sheaf, and f:A→B any morphism. Let n=r+s. On any open U take a tuple a of r sections of A, c of s sections of B, an index j∈Fin s, and d∈A(U) with c_j=f(d). The section of ∧^n B [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power] given by the concatenation (f(a_1),…,f(a_r),c_1,…,c_s), reindexed by n=r+s, is zero.

source.place: Proof of (*), determinant paragraph: exterior-power universal properties and independence of quotient lifts

proof.text: Choose the local generators data in IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank. On an object V mapping both to U and to a cover member, the invertible presentation gives A.over(q.X i) isomorphic to the free sheaf on ULift(Fin r). Evaluate this isomorphism and apply the proved sectionsLinearEquivOfIsoFree. Transport Pi.basisFun and reindex with Equiv.ulift to obtain a basis of A(V) indexed by Fin r. This uses only the existing, proved finite-free section interface.

Prove alternating_zero_on_large_image directly: freeze the arguments outside a finite subset t and compose the remaining arguments with f. The resulting alternating map on A is zero by Module.Basis.ext_alternating, since an injective tuple of basis indices would give card(t) <= r. Specialize t to the r initial positions together with the position r+j; these are distinct, so card(t)=r+1. Each selected argument is in the image of f, the extra one by hc. Apply this to exteriorPower.ιMulti, obtaining zero already in the sectionwise exterior power. No exterior-power basis theorem or sheafification injectivity is used.

Use naturality of the sheafification adjunction unit and the unique restriction map on pure wedges directly, so no private helper from ExteriorTensorLiftHomExt is imported. Naturality of f identifies the restricted tuple with the concatenation of the restricted source entries and restricted c; restricting hc identifies its jth entry. The sectionwise zero maps to zero under the sheafification unit. Finally apply separatedness of the exterior sheaf to the covering sieve q.coversTop U. The same finite-cardinality argument covers rank zero; s=0 has no j.

lean.statement:
theorem exteriorSheaf_rank_wedge_eq_zero {X : Scheme.{v}} {A B : X.Modules}
    (f : A ⟶ B) (r n s : ℕ) (hr : n = r + s) [A.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r]
    (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin r → A.val.obj (op U))
    (c : Fin s → B.val.obj (op U)) (j : Fin s) (d : A.val.obj (op U))
    (hc : c j = f.val.app (op U) d) :
    exteriorSheafSection B n U
      (fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun k ↦ f.val.app (op U) (a k)) c (Fin.cast hr i)) = 0
